<a id="symbol-CivilDate"></a>
## `CivilDate` · immutable record · [source](dates.aug#L10)

Gregorian calendar date, including dates before the historical calendar cutover. It takes `year` as an integer, kept read-only (Year from 1 to 9999), `month` as an integer, kept read-only (Month from 1 to 12), and `day` as an integer, kept read-only (Day from 1 to the actual month's length). Construction can fail with `ConversionError`.

<a id="symbol-CivilDate.initialize"></a>
### `CivilDate.initialize` · [source](dates.aug#L10)

It checks that `year` is at least `1` and `year` is at most `9999` and `month` is at least `1` and `month` is at most `12` and `day` is at least `1` and `day` is at most [`_daysInMonth`](dates.aug.md#symbol-_daysInMonth) with `year` and `month`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. [source](dates.aug#L12-L15)

<a id="symbol-parseCivilDate"></a>
## `parseCivilDate` · [source](dates.aug#L29)

Parse exactly ten ASCII bytes in YYYY-MM-DD form. No whitespace or time suffix is accepted. It takes `text` as a string.

It checks that `text.byteLength` equals `10`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. It sets `bytes` to the UTF-8 bytes of `text`. It sets `year` to [`asciiSlice`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiSlice) with `input` from `bytes`, `start` `0`, and `end` `4`. [source](dates.aug#L30-L33)

It sets `month` to [`asciiSlice`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiSlice) with `input` from `bytes`, `start` `5`, and `end` `7`. It sets `day` to [`asciiSlice`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiSlice) with `input` from `bytes`, `start` `8`, and `end` `10`. It checks that [`asciiSlice`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiSlice) with `input` from `bytes`, `start` `4`, and `end` `5` equals `"-"` and [`asciiSlice`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiSlice) with `input` from `bytes`, `start` `7`, and `end` `8` equals `"-"` and `year.isDecimal` returns true and `month.isDecimal` returns true and `day.isDecimal` returns true. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. [source](dates.aug#L34-L39)

It returns a [`CivilDate`](dates.aug.md#symbol-CivilDate) with `year` from `year.parseInteger`, `month` from `month.parseInteger`, and `day` from `day.parseInteger`. [source](dates.aug#L40)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
parseCivilDate(string text) returns CivilDate unless ConversionError
```

It takes `text` as a string. Failures can raise `ConversionError` (Malformed text or an invalid Gregorian date).

</details>

<a id="symbol-formatCivilDate"></a>
## `formatCivilDate` · [source](dates.aug#L43)

Format a validated calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD, padding each field with zeroes. It takes `value` as [`CivilDate`](dates.aug.md#symbol-CivilDate). It returns the text `{_pad with value from value.year and width 4}-{_pad with value from value.month and width 2}-{_pad with value from value.day and width 2}`. [source](dates.aug#L44)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
formatCivilDate(CivilDate value) returns string
```

It takes `value` as [`CivilDate`](dates.aug.md#symbol-CivilDate).

</details>

<a id="symbol-compareCivilDates"></a>
## `compareCivilDates` · [source](dates.aug#L53)

Compare calendar fields chronologically; return -1, 0 or 1 without arithmetic overflow. It takes `left` and `right` as [`CivilDate`](dates.aug.md#symbol-CivilDate).

If `left.year` is less than `right.year`, it returns `-1`. If `left.year` is greater than `right.year`, it returns `1`. If `left.month` is less than `right.month`, it returns `-1`. If `left.month` is greater than `right.month`, it returns `1`. [source](dates.aug#L54-L61)

If `left.day` is less than `right.day`, it returns `-1`. It returns `1` if `left.day` is greater than `right.day`, or `0` otherwise. [source](dates.aug#L62-L66)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
compareCivilDates(CivilDate left, CivilDate right) returns int
```

It takes `left` and `right` as [`CivilDate`](dates.aug.md#symbol-CivilDate).

</details>

<a id="symbol-_daysInMonth"></a>
## `_daysInMonth` · [source](dates.aug#L17)

It is private to its defining scope. It takes `year` and `month` as integers. If `month` equals `2`, it returns `29` if (`year` remainder after division by `400`) equals `0` or ((`year` remainder after division by `4`) equals `0` and (`year` remainder after division by `100`) does not equal `0`), or `28` otherwise. It returns `30` if `month` equals `4` or `month` equals `6` or `month` equals `9` or `month` equals `11`, or `31` otherwise. [source](dates.aug#L18-L24)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
_daysInMonth(int year, int month) returns int
```

It takes `year` and `month` as integers.

</details>

<a id="symbol-_pad"></a>
## `_pad` · [source](dates.aug#L46)

It is private to its defining scope. It takes `value` and `width` as integers.

It sets `text` to the text `{value}`. While `text.byteLength` is less than `width`, it builds `text` as the text `0{text}`. After the loop, it returns `text`. [source](dates.aug#L47-L50)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
_pad(int value, int width) returns string
```

It takes `value` and `width` as integers.

</details>

## Dependencies

It uses [`asciiSlice`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiSlice) from `ascii`.

Built-in operations follow the [language reference](https://greenpandastudios.github.io/augscript/language-constructs).
